footnote_text: Represents restricted shares of Class A Common Stock (the "MC-2 Tranche") granted pursuant to a Restricted Stock Award Agreement dated October 20, 2026 under the Health In Tech, Inc. Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan"), the grant of which was contingent upon, and became effective upon, stockholder approval of an amendment to the Plan at the Issuer's 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on November 10, 2026. The shares will be automatically forfeited without consideration unless the Issuer's market capitalization, based on the 10-day volume-weighted average price, exceeds $300 million on or before December 31, 2028 (the "Achievement Date"). Thereafter, the shares vest in twelve equal monthly installments, subject to continued service. If the Achievement Date falls before the 15th calendar day of the month, vesting commences on such 15th day, and if after, commences on the 1st day of the next calendar month.

Represents restricted shares of Class A Common Stock (the "MC-3 Tranche") granted on the same basis as described in footnote (1), except that the market capitalization threshold is $500 million and the deadline is December 31, 2029.
